PART I - County Almanac: Alder County

Alder County lies in the river plain between the Fenner Marsh and the Ridgeway hills. Its county seat is Mossbridge, where the courthouse, the library, and the offices of Halvern & Moss stand within a short walk of one another. The gazetteer of Alder County towns lists nine towns: Mossbridge, Alder Falls, Kettner Junction, East Rill, Port Sanger, Thurlow Flats, Wexler's Crossing, North Fenner, Dunmore Landing. The county is drained by the River Rill, crossed at Port Sanger by the bridge described elsewhere in this volume, and served by the East Rill canal cut. This almanac gathers the county's history, its notable records, and its people, in the plain style of the county press.



Biographical Notices of Alder County Residents



Alma Osgood (1880-1957), stationmaster of Dunmore Landing. She was apprenticed at fourteen and kept the same trade for over forty years, serving on the parish council and the bridge committee. Contemporaries remembered a fondness for beekeeping and a habit of recording the river level each morning in a pocket book. The family plot lies in the south churchyard, marked by a stone of local grit.

Jonas Pruitt (1869-1954), postmistress of North Fenner. He was apprenticed at fourteen and kept the same trade for over forty years, serving on the parish council and the library committee. PART II - Company and County Records

PART IV - Technical Manual: The Model 7 Pump

This manual governs the installation, operation, and overhaul of the Halvern & Moss Model 7 pump. All procedures assume the works isolation certificate has been signed and the suction line drained.

## Procedure 1 - Torque the shaft sleeve
1. Isolate the pump and post the notice board. 2. Torque the shaft sleeve in the order shown on plate 31, recording each measurement in the overhaul book. 3. Where the shaft sleeve shows scoring deeper than 8 thousandths, renew rather than dress. 4. Reassemble with new jointing, torque the studs in cross order to 37 lb-ft, and run the pump for 33 minutes against a closed valve before signing the certificate. Failure to observe this procedure voids the works guarantee and has caused, in recorded cases, gland failure within the week.

## Procedure 2 - Prime the impeller
1. Isolate the pump and post the notice board. 2. Prime the impeller in the order shown on plate 9, recording each measurement in the overhaul book. 3. Where the impeller shows scoring deeper than 3 thousandths, renew rather than dress. 4. Reassemble with new jointing, torque the studs in cross order to 47 lb-ft, and run the pump for 33 minutes against a closed valve before signing the certificate. Failure to observe this procedure voids the works guarantee and has caused, in recorded cases, gland failure within the week.

## Procedure 3 - Torque the shaft sleeve
1. Isolate the pump and post the notice board. 2. Torque the shaft sleeve in the order shown on plate 20, recording each measurement in the overhaul book. 3. Where the shaft sleeve shows scoring deeper than 9 thousandths, renew rather than dress. 4.
